Worklist induction:root has zero-step closure;every fresh neighbor extends symmetric relation closure. Assignment before enqueue bounds total pushes by V and prevents recursion/cycle growth. When queue empty,each reached vertex has all neighbors assigned this class or already processed. Earlier components cannot border an unassigned root:their completed floods would have reached it. Thus each flood is exactly a component;root sweep covers all V vertices.

Dense labels invariant:before root r,all positions<r assigned,each prior component owns a root<=r,and labels range below count. A fresh root means count<=r<V,so increment is machine-safe and assigned label<count+1<=V;unassigned sentinel usize::MAX is never a class ID. Final sweep assigns all positions,one nonempty class per increment. Partition consumes each tag exactly once and moves payload without recloning;class_of addresses actual output vector,repairing old root-ID defect.
